update.name: centred_state_band_spectral_projection

operations.label: damped_localization
operations.purpose: Find a data-supported circle using low-frequency damped data
operations.transition: warm-up at the refined best grid circle; failure ends the fit

details.refinement: best of six coordinate neighbors from the best grid point; halve steps if none improves
